name: Devil's Glove

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (rare wood chips); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Scent of Death
traits.summary: Creatures that can smell have Advantage on Perception checks to find it.
traits.text: Creatures that can smell have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to find the devil's glove.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The devil's glove climbs difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.summary: +4, 1d4+2 Bludgeoning plus 2d6 Necrotic; it attaches (and makes no Tendril attack on anyone else) and the target is Poisoned until its next turn if it can smell it.
actions.text: Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage, and the glove attaches to the target. While attached it can't use Tendril on other targets, and a target that can smell it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. The glove detaches by spending 5 feet of movement; the target, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can pull it off with an action.

actions.name: Decaying Bloom
actions.summary: Twice a day: 10-ft emanation, DC 12 Con save or 2d8 Necrotic and no Hit Point recovery until its next turn; half damage on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Symbiosis
bonus_actions.summary: Bonds with a willing creature it touches: the creature needs no food or drink and has Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned. Ends on either one's death, by its choice, or on re-use.

summary: A tiny fungal hand that clings with a necrotic tendril, blooms rot around it and, bonded, feeds its master and wards off poison.
